title: person-keypair — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins protocol::derive_person_keypair_wrap_key_from_normalized under the v0.2 salt domain 'myne.v0.2 argon2id-person-keypair|' (the B2B identity substrate, decisions/protocol/0592). Vault-independent: the salt's account_number_hash slot carries the phrase-derived person_id_hash, not any vault account hash, so two people with the same phrase derive different wrap keys. Inputs are hex-encoded for cross-language portability.

input_phrase_utf8_hex.description: UTF-8 bytes of the already-normalized recovery phrase (caller normalizes per §3.4 before this call).

input_person_id_hash_hex.description: 16-byte phrase-derived person id hash (SHA-256('myne.person-id|' || phrase)[:16]); occupies the account_number_hash salt slot.
